2607.29082.title: Can Zero-Shot LLMs Predict Child Malnutrition? A Fairness and Temporal Robustness Study
2607.29082.paper_summary: Child malnutrition remains a major public health challenge in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in South Asia, where early identification of vulnerable children is critical for timely intervention and resource allocation. This study aims to evaluate the feasibility, fairness, and temporal robustness of using a pretrained large language model (LLM) in a zero-shot setting for child stunting prediction using population health survey data. Using Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey (BDHS) data collected between 2007 and 2022, we transformed maternal, child, healthcare, and household characteristics into semantically interpretable prompt-based representations and evaluated GPT-4o-mini for zero-shot stunting prediction, comparing its performance against a random forest baseline and assessing fairness across demographic and socioeconomic groups as well as temporal robustness across survey waves. The results demonstrate that zero-shot inference using GPT-4o-mini achieved comparable balanced accuracy to the supervised baseline while exhibiting substantially higher sensitivity for identifying stunting cases, relatively consistent performance across child sex groups, and stable predictive behaviour across BDHS waves; however, important fairness disparities were observed across residence and household wealth categories, highlighting the need for further investigation before deployment of foundation models in public health prediction settings.
2607.29082.paper_summary_zh: 兒童營養不良在低收入和中等收入國家仍然是一個主要的公共衛生挑戰，特別是在南亞，及早識別脆弱兒童對於及時干預和資源分配至關重要。本研究旨在評估在零樣本設置中使用預訓練的大型語言模型（LLM）進行兒童生長遲緩預測的可行性、公平性和時間穩健性，這是基於人口健康調查數據進行的。利用2007年至2022年間收集的孟加拉國人口與健康調查（BDHS）數據，我們將母親、兒童、醫療保健和家庭特徵轉換為語義可解釋的基於提示的表示，並評估GPT-4o-mini在零樣本生長遲緩預測中的表現，將其性能與隨機森林基準進行比較，並評估不同人口和社會經濟群體的公平性以及不同調查波次的時間穩健性。結果顯示，使用GPT-4o-mini的零樣本推斷達到了與監督基準相當的平衡準確率，同時在識別生長遲緩案例方面表現出顯著更高的敏感性，在兒童性別群體之間的表現相對一致，並且在BDHS波次中顯示出穩定的預測行為；然而，在居住地和家庭財富類別之間觀察到重要的公平性差異，這凸顯了在公共衛生預測環境中部署基礎模型之前需要進一步研究的必要性。
